connector.name: Lightning Enable MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: AI agent Lightning payments: invoices, wallets, L402 access, API discovery, budgets, and commerce.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the NuGet package LightningEnable.Mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the refined-element account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: STRIKE_API_KEY
env.description: Strike API key for Lightning payments (recommended wallet)

env.name: NWC_CONNECTION_STRING
env.description: Nostr Wallet Connect URI (for NWC wallets like CoinOS, CLINK, Alby Hub)

env.name: LND_REST_HOST
env.description: LND REST API host (e.g., localhost:8080)

env.name: LND_MACAROON_HEX
env.description: LND admin macaroon in hex format

env.name: OPENNODE_API_KEY
env.description: OpenNode API key (direct payments only, no L402 support)

env.name: OPENNODE_ENVIRONMENT
env.description: OpenNode environment: production or dev (testnet)

env.name: LIGHTNING_ENABLE_API_KEY
env.description: Lightning Enable API key for agent registration and ASA publishing (Agentic Commerce subscription)

env.name: AGENT_RELAY_URL
env.description: Nostr relay URL for agent events (default: wss://agents.lightningenable.com)
